name: liquid-glass-studio
description: Design, implement, tune, and review liquid glass style interfaces: refraction, frost, rim light, motion, native glass APIs, accessibility fallbacks, and performance, with an original engine and a live lab.

interface.longDescription: A routing skill and focused workflows for liquid glass style interfaces: design rules for when glass helps, optics and displacement maps, web rendering tiers with honest browser support, native SwiftUI, UIKit and AppKit glass APIs, motion and morphing, accessibility fallbacks, performance, a live tuning lab, and evidence-based review. Ships an original dependency-free engine, a backdrop contrast checker, cited notes on five open-source glass libraries, and a survey of existing agent skills.
defaultPrompt: Add liquid glass styling to this app's navigation and controls, with fallbacks for browsers and users that need them, and verify it in a real browser.
Review this glass UI for legibility, fallbacks, accessibility, and performance, and report evidence before suggesting fixes.
